scientific_question: Does one nonlinear model of completed top-five Bybit L2 and aggressive-flow state identify an imminent balance-to-imbalance transition strongly enough for a direction-neutral two-sided conditional-entry payoff to survive realistic BBO execution and 12/18/24bp costs?
smc_ict_translation: The model does not predict bullish or bearish direction; it predicts whether balance is likely to deliver into displacement.
A high hazard score arms equal buy-stop and sell-stop entries outside the current executable spread, analogous to waiting on both sides of internal liquidity for actual delivery to reveal direction.
The first triggered side becomes the position; the opposite order remains live until its modeled cancel-effective time, so a liquidity sweep of both sides produces an explicit double-trigger loss.
Target and stop are fixed structural displacement distances. There is no second pattern and no elapsed-time liquidation.

data.availability_clock: Tardis local_timestamp used in the source-state construction and raw trade trigger stream
data.fit_source: 2022-07-01 completed 100ms state plus exact SHA-identified raw trades
data.conditional_development_source: 2023-07-01 completed 100ms state plus exact SHA-identified raw trades
data.third_party_boundary: A positive result is discovery evidence only until independently reconstructed from official Bybit data or another independent source.

chronology.development: untouched 2023-07-01, opened by the runner only if one frozen fit-account survivor exists
chronology.decision_rule: A decision at timestamp t uses only completed state and raw trades with local_timestamp strictly before t. Labels and order paths cannot cross a source segment or UTC sample-day boundary.

feature_rules.normalization: No future or full-day normalization. HGBT receives the raw fixed transforms; missing decision features make the row unavailable.

hazard_label.reference: fresh executable midpoint at decision t
hazard_label.positive: The maximum absolute log midpoint move in [t+100ms,t+30s] reaches at least 40bp.
hazard_label.unavailable: Any stale/invalid state, source-segment change or sample-day boundary before the full horizon makes the label unavailable.
hazard_label.overlap: Overlapping fit labels are allowed for model estimation but are never counted as independent account trades.

model.sample_weight: Inverse class-frequency weights fitted on fit_train only.
model.score_threshold: The 99th percentile of model scores on fit_score_calibration, frozen before fit-account paths.
model.diagnostic_baseline: One-variable volatility_30s_bps score; the HGBT must improve calibration AUC by at least 0.02.

entry_pair.semantics: Two independent equal-quantity contract-price stop-market-style orders; no exchange-atomic OCO is assumed.
entry_pair.first_trigger_eligible_interval: raw trades with local_timestamp at least decision time plus 100ms
entry_pair.trigger: first 100ms bin whose observed raw trade maximum reaches the upper trigger or minimum reaches the lower trigger
entry_pair.fill: first fresh completed-state ask for a buy or bid for a sell at or after trigger plus latency
entry_pair.double_trigger: The opposite order remains active until first-fill time plus cancel latency. A trigger strictly before cancel effectiveness creates an equal opposite market fill and immediate flattening. Same-bin two-sided triggers are a double-trigger round trip.
entry_pair.global_slot: One pending pair or one open position across the account.

exit.trigger_stream: raw trades after the reduce-only orders become active 100ms after first fill
exit.fill: first fresh adverse executable BBO at or after trigger plus latency; a favorable rebound cannot improve the fill
exit.source_gap_or_day_boundary: An unresolved accepted position receives its full planned structural stop loss plus the registered cost; it is never deleted.

account.participation_cap: 0.1% of raw traded quote notional observed in [decision-3s,decision)
account.sizing: min(3x NAV, participation capacity, NAV*1%/(stop_fraction+cost_fraction)); no risk or leverage search
account.same_event_paths: Signals, triggers, fills and exits are identical across cost paths; only sizing and explicit cost cashflow differ.
account.counterfactual_winner_removal: For any preliminary survivor, remove the largest positive 10% of 12bp event keys before global-slot arbitration and replay from initial NAV.

freeze_and_development.freeze: If multiple payoff cells pass every fit gate, freeze the one with highest 300ms-cancel 18bp winner-removed return; ties use lower drawdown then cell_id.
freeze_and_development.development_open_rule: The 2023 state and raw trade files may be parsed only after the frozen fit survivor and fit result hashes are written.
freeze_and_development.development_gate: At least 50 trades; positive total return at 18/24bp; positive 18bp median, PF>=1.10 and winner-removed return; top-five share<=0.40; 300ms cancel 18bp positive; double-trigger fraction<=0.15; winner-removed 18bp observed-sample-day growth>=1%.
freeze_and_development.next_stage: A development survivor requires a new unchanged-rule multi-day pre-2024 claim and independent source reconstruction before any 2024 data, ranking or practical-use decision.

hard_invalidations: Any future label column from the reused state Parquet is used.
Any feature includes raw trade or state information at or after the decision timestamp.
The opposite entry is canceled before the registered cancel-effective time.
Same-bin entry or target/stop ambiguity is resolved favorably.
A trigger without a timely fresh fill quote is charged as an accepted position rather than a rejected no-fill order.
An unresolved accepted position is deleted instead of receiving the conservative structural-stop loss.
The 2023 source is parsed without a frozen fit survivor.
Any 2024-2026 source is acquired or opened.
